Use case: product-mockup
Asset type: salon service image for landscape row thumbnails and service page hero crops.
Scene/backdrop: clean warm cream tabletop with a subtle blush pink ceramic accent.
Style/medium: photorealistic premium editorial still-life photography, realistic metal, ceramic and fabric textures.
Composition/framing: single landscape 3:2 photograph, close overhead three-quarter view, key objects centered with open margins so the image works at small thumbnail size.
Lighting/mood: soft natural window light, subtle shadows, calm refined beauty studio atmosphere.
Color palette: warm cream, blush pink and small burgundy accents.
Constraints: objects only. No people, faces, hands, body parts, mannequins, portraits, text, labels, branding, logos, watermarks or collages. Unbranded tools and containers.
Primary request: a minimal lash extension tools still life.
Subject: one open lash extension tray with neat rows of delicate dark lash fans, and two elegant curved precision tweezers in gold and stainless steel, arranged cleanly near a blush ceramic dish. The lash fans are small individual extension clusters in orderly tray rows, never human eyelids or eyes. A small folded burgundy cloth accent may sit beneath the tools.
